description: Payment card number checks without storing anything: Luhn checksum, brand / network from the IIN (Visa, Mastercard incl. 2-series, Amex, Discover, Diners, JCB, UnionPay, Maestro, Mir, Elo, Hipercard, Verve, RuPay, Dankort, Troy, UATP), allowed lengths, CVV length, card-number spacing, known public test numbers (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen) and expiry validity. Returns only the PCI-safe first 6 / last 4 — never the full number. Up to 100 numbers per call. POST so numbers stay out of URLs and logs. Returns JSON with: masked, display, first6, last4, length, brand, brandName, luhn. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/card-validate
name: card_validate
title: Card Validate
